 Free guidance helps individuals, families and self-employed workers review coverage across Central Florida ORLANDO, Fl. - October 21, 2026 - Daniels Health Advisors LLC is helping Orlando-area individuals, families and self-employed workers prepare for 2027 health insurance enrollment with a checklist covering income estimates, doctor networks, prescription coverage and total plan costs.
 The local need is substantial. CMS county-level data show that 627,982 consumers in Orange, Osceola and Seminole counties selected a HealthCare.gov plan during the 2026 open enrollment period. That regional total includes 399,974 plan selections in Orange County, 151,333 in Osceola County and 76,675 in Seminole County.
 HealthCare.gov currently lists November 1, 2026, through January 15, 2027, as the open enrollment period for 2027 Marketplace coverage. To begin coverage January 1, consumers must select a plan by December 15, 2026, and pay their first premium when due. Residents should confirm current deadlines at HealthCare.gov .
 What to review before choosing a health plan
 Prepare an income estimate. Estimate household income for 2027, the year of coverage. Self-employed applicants should account for estimated net self-employment income. Review the estimate if circumstances change and seek tax guidance when needed.
 Check doctors and prescriptions. Confirm preferred doctors, hospitals and medications against the specific plan being considered. Verify current details with the insurer and providers before enrolling.
 Compare the full cost of coverage. Review premiums, deductibles, copays, coinsurance and applicable out-of-pocket limits alongside expected care needs. The monthly premium is only one part of the household budget.
 Review renewal notices and deadlines. Compare available 2027 plans before allowing existing coverage to renew. Benefits, costs and provider networks can change between plan years.
 Local help for households and small businesses
 Daniels Health Advisors helps residents in Orlando and across Orange, Seminole and Osceola counties review available coverage based on their ZIP code, household needs and budget. Consultations cover plan documents, provider networks, prescription benefits and the costs people may face when using care.
 Self-employed professionals and 1099 contractors can get help comparing ACA Marketplace options and preparing for enrollment. Business owners with employees can also discuss small-group health insurance and Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangements, or ICHRAs. Employer arrangements have separate eligibility and administration requirements.
 Private PPO and other health plans may also be considered where appropriate. Some private plans use medical underwriting, may exclude pre-existing conditions and may offer different benefits and protections from ACA Marketplace plans. Availability and approval vary by product and state.
 Consultations are available at no charge. Daniels Health Advisors receives carrier commissions when a client enrolls, and compensation can vary by insurer. Clients remain responsible for premiums and applicable health care costs.
 Residents can review the Florida open enrollment guide or request a consultation at danielshealthadvisors.com .
 About Daniels Health Advisors 
 Daniels Health Advisors LLC provides independent health insurance guidance in Central Florida. It assists individuals, families, self-employed workers and small businesses with coverage comparisons and enrollment questions. Guidance depends on each client's circumstances and the terms of available plans.
 Licensed insurance agent: Paul Daniels, NPN 20986580, Florida license G065122.
